source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: Juha found an egg on the road.
He said: from the egg a chicken will come.
And from the chicken there will be many eggs.
And from the eggs many chickens.
And from the chickens a lot of money.

sentences.ar: בזמן שהוא חשב, הביצה נפלה ונשברה.
sentences.en: While he was thinking, the egg fell and broke.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: כל הכסף שלי הלך.
sentences.en: He said: all my money is gone.
